title: PII masks, tags and row filters defined in code are not applied in the workspace
detail: 50_grants_and_tags.sql:357-447 creates pii_clear_text_mask and masks bronze email/iban/ip_address. Deployed catalog: 0 column masks, 0 routines, 0 column tags, 0 row filters.
impact: Clear-text Bronze PII (email, IBAN, IP) readable by anyone with SELECT; contradicts Art.25/32 design. Blocks cut-over.

evidence.excerpt: ALTER STREAMING TABLE eurostream.bronze.orders ALTER COLUMN email SET MASK

title: Workspace runs in US East (Ohio); ADR-0001 requires EU-only processing
detail: All billed SKUs are *_US_EAST_OHIO, including INTER_REGION_EGRESS. ADR-0001 says all storage and processing is pinned to EU regions; infra/main.tf pins eu-central-1.
impact: EU residency claim does not hold for the Databricks target; a cut-over moves EU personal data to the US.

evidence.excerpt: All storage and processing is pinned to EU regions

title: Databricks build ran on one day only (2026-09-28); half the jobs failed at least once
detail: 4 jobs in system.lakeflow: eurostream_bootstrap 1/4 ok, eurostream_pipeline 1/5 ok, eurostream_export_lake 7/10 ok, eurostream_art17_erasure 7/8 ok. All runs 2026-09-28 04:50-09:59 UTC; none since.
impact: No evidence the target runs unattended; go/no-go cannot rest on one rehearsal day.

title: Deployed jobs do not match the bundle; fraud stream, quality gate and orchestrator are absent
detail: Bundle defines eurostream_bronze_continuous, eurostream_fraud_continuous, medallion_refresh, quality_gate, export_lake, orchestrator. Workspace has eurostream_bootstrap/pipeline/art17_erasure/export_lake (UI-created).
impact: Continuous fraud scoring and the 4-hourly DAG that replace the Python GitHub Actions run do not exist in the target.

title: Bundle ships continuous ingest and the 4-hourly orchestrator PAUSED; UI is declared source of truth
detail: jobs.yml:20 and :376 pause_status PAUSED. databricks.yml:3 and README:91 say the manual UI path is the source of truth; runbook docs/databricks/ is gitignored.
impact: Cut-over is not reproducible from the repo; a rebuild depends on an unshared runbook.

evidence.excerpt: The manual Databricks UI path remains the source of truth.

title: GEO_MISMATCH fires once per window in Python, on every event in Databricks
detail: Python sets stats.geo_mismatch and skips repeats in the window (streaming.py:134-146). Databricks yields an alert for every mismatched payment (03_fraud_streaming.py:378-388). Other thresholds (velocity 5/300s, z>3, baseline 3) match.
impact: Alert volume changes on cut-over; downstream fraud_summary counts not comparable.

title: Turso sync and its erasure cascade have no Databricks counterpart
detail: Python dual-writes to Turso (src/eurostream/turso.py) and cascades erasure there (erasure.py:215-240). No Turso reference in databricks/ pipelines, notebooks or SQL.
impact: Turso is either retired at cut-over or left holding PII that Databricks erasure never reaches.

title: pii_manifest.json omits payments.iban and clicks.ip_address
detail: Manifest lists only bronze.orders email/iban. Python erasure anonymizes payments.iban and clicks.ip_address (erasure.py:199-206); Databricks masks them (50_grants_and_tags.sql:437-441).
impact: Manifest-driven tagging or audits under-report PII.

title: Python API exposes erasure and data endpoints without authentication, CORS *
detail: api.py:51-52 adds CORSMiddleware allow_origins=['*']; POST /erasure-requests (:173) and /erase/{customer_id} (:206) declare no auth dependency.
impact: Risk persists while the Python stack stays live; resolved by the Databricks App (OBO + preview token) if retired.

title: Hard-coded default PII salt in Python; Databricks reads it from Spark conf
detail: config.py:22 PII_SALT = "eurostream-pii-salt" used by hash_pii and build_silver. Databricks silver_pseudonymize.py:31 reads spark.conf eurostream.pii.salt.
impact: Hashes are reversible by dictionary if the default is used; salts differ between stacks so Silver hashes will not match after cut-over.

title: SAT run 1 (2026-10-05): 23 of 52 checks failed, 3 of them High
detail: High: GOV-21 metastore admin not a group, GOV-34 audit logs not monitored, NS-11 IP access list not enforced. Medium incl. GOV-42 jobs not run as service principal, DP-5/DP-11 result downloads enabled.
impact: Workspace not production-hardened for EU personal data.

title: Databricks erasure is broader than Python but does not verify the remote Hugging Face copy
detail: 02_article17_erasure.py covers Bronze masks, quarantine, fraud_alerts purge, Silver/Gold refresh and lake Volume rewrite; its verify scope says remote Hugging Face not verified (:911). Python erasure never touches the lake export.
impact: Public HF dataset may retain erased customers if de-identification is ever incomplete.
